These compounds are known to interact with the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3, indicating a possible pathway where Faropenem medoxomil may influence the transporter through its interaction with these intermediates. The evidence suggests a chain of interactions where the antibiotic may modulate the transporter via metabolic pathways involving these compounds, though the exact mechanism remains unclear. The integration of these pathways highlights the role of metabolic intermediates in mediating drug-target interactions, underscoring the complexity of drug-target relationships in biological systems.
